claimBoundary: No battery was acquired or tested. This contract separates traceability, acute harm screening, and lifetime equivalence. It does not convert a null acute pilot into evidence of non-interference.

verifiedBasis.finding: INL compared partial RPT groups with a no-RPT control. Multiple capacity tests and a 0 C pulse test accelerated degradation, while other components changed measured performance differently; the report requested longer control-comparison work before standardizing the mini RPT.

A capacity-triggered RPT schedule produced 44 percent more aging cycles than fixed 200-cycle spacing during the first 100 days, but the study did not establish schedule equivalence for lifetime, temperature, throughput, and impedance.
Traceability belongs to a measurement result and requires a documented calibration chain and uncertainty; calibration alone does not establish fitness for purpose.
The uncertainty budget must include short-term repeatability and, where relevant, reproducibility, stability, resolution, nonlinearity, hysteresis, drift, and configuration differences.

marginRule.formula: For metric i, long-term equivalence may open only when U95_i < M_i <= min(S_i, H_i), where U95_i is the expanded measurement uncertainty, S_i is the smallest scientifically consequential change fixed without arm outcomes, and H_i is the laboratory or product safety/qualification allowance.
marginRule.emptyIntervalDecision: If no positive M_i satisfies the interval, the measurement cannot support an equivalence claim; improve the measurement or abandon the dense schedule.
marginRule.antiCircularity: Neither M_i, S_i, H_i, variance inflation, nor the estimand may be chosen from observed dense-versus-conventional arm differences.
marginRule.multiplicity: Four co-primary metrics use Bonferroni one-sided alpha 0.0125; every metric must pass.
marginRule.currentVerdict: The searched primary and metrology sources do not supply universal numerical S_i or H_i values for the still-unspecified RC59 chemistry, build, RPT waveform, and safety system. Supplying numbers now would be unsupported, so long-term enrollment remains blocked.

metricRegistry.estimand: difference in registered end-of-life time or cycle count between dense and conventional RPT schedules
metricRegistry.unit: cycles or equivalent full cycles, fixed before enrollment

metricRegistry.estimand: within-cell or parallel-arm increase in registered peak surface temperature caused by the RPT action
additional charge throughput imposed by the observation schedule through the same adjudication time
schedule-induced change in the preregistered impedance summary at fixed SOC, temperature, rest, and frequency definition
metricRegistry.unit: ohm or percent, fixed before enrollment

acuteSentinel.purpose: Reject a large, immediately detectable perturbation before committing to a long-duration equivalence study.
acuteSentinel.sample: Twelve disjoint sacrificial cells, one from each manufacturing block, randomized six to dense-then-conventional and six to conventional-then-dense order.
acuteSentinel.controls: Freeze SOC, temperature, rest, connection, firmware, and waveform; record complete current, voltage, surface temperature, elapsed time, and impedance provenance. Use a washout justified from the cell relaxation response, not a fixed convenient duration.
acuteSentinel.successLanguage: No registered large acute perturbation detected; lifetime equivalence remains untested.
acuteSentinel.reject: Stop on any hard safety breach, missing traceability edge, failed margin registry, material sequence carryover, or adjusted interval crossing the preregistered acute rejection threshold.
acuteSentinel.forbiddenConclusion: A non-significant acute comparison is not evidence that lifetime is unchanged.

longTermEquivalence.design: Disjoint parallel randomization of dense versus conventional RPT schedules within manufacturing blocks; no crossover because degradation carryover is irreversible.
longTermEquivalence.sizing: After external margins are signed, use blinded pooled variance and registered correlation or clustering inflation. The RC58 known-variance normal values are lower-bound sensitivity calculations, not the final sample size.
longTermEquivalence.pass: Every two one-sided equivalence interval lies inside its signed M_i, no safety stop occurs, missingness remains inside its registered bound, and an independent implementation reproduces the verdict.
longTermEquivalence.stop: Stop rather than weaken a margin, pool an unregistered build, replace failed cells after randomization, or inspect lifetime rank to choose cadence.

nextExecutableAction: A qualified laboratory must freeze the exact chemistry, cell format, RPT waveform, safety SOP, instrument chain, and four S/H values. The metrology owner then estimates U95 from calibration and gauge studies; software opens the study only if all four intervals U95 < M <= min(S,H) are non-empty and signed.
